messages:
ashley: quick sync — ran through the audit coverage matrix for API gateway, auth, console, billing, runtime. found a few concrete gaps we should triage this sprint. TL;DR: small schema bump + owners and tickets.

priya: list them out? I can start making tickets. :female-technologist:

ashley: API gateway — missing `response_size`, `backend_latency`, and consistent `request_id` propagation for retries. also no uniform `client_ip` for proxied requests. P1/P2 depending on service.

matt: auth — no explicit `role_change` or `permission_grant` events for SSO flows. we also miss `token_revoked` with actor metadata. P0 for enterprise customers.

devon: console — admin actions (policy edits, user deprovision, api-key create/delete) are logged but payloads omit `actor_email` and `actor_id`. customer-facing audit exports need stable field names.

ashley: billing — we don't emit `invoice_view` or `billing_export` events. downstream compliance customers asked specifically for an `invoice_downloaded` event. keep as P2 but add to backlog for next release.

matt: runtime — missing `model_fallback`, `model_load`, and `kv_cache_clear` events. these are important for debugging regressions and for audit trails when customers request root-cause. P1.

priya: agree with priorities. for schema changes we should avoid breaking exports. suggest add `schema_version` top-level and make new fields optional for 30d before flipping.

ashley: decision: add `schema_version: 2.1` for the new audit fields. migration plan: 1) emit new fields as opt-in (30d) 2) enable by default behind feature flag (60d) 3) bump docs + customer-facing export examples (90d).

devon: customer validation — I can draft a simple JSON schema for the exportable events and a CI check that validates sample exports for customers during handoffs. will need input on required vs optional fields.

matt: i'll prototype the gateway + runtime changes this week. will post a diff of the event shape. example snippet: ```json
{
  "schema_version": "2.1",
  "event_type": "api.request",
  "request_id": "r_123",
  "client_ip": "1.2.3.4",
  "response_size": 2345
}
```

priya: i'll create the tickets: one per service with checklists (schema, prod emit, docs, customer export test, rollout). assign `owner` field in ticket to whoever volunteers. will link PRs.

ashley: owners: API gateway -> matt, auth -> ashley, console -> devon, billing -> priya, runtime -> matt. add `security-bot` to each ticket for automated log assertions. :white_check_mark:

security-bot: automated note: created checklist template `audit-coverage-template` and will auto-add to any ticket with label `audit-coverage`.

devon: quick Q on KMS and sensitive fields — should we never emit full key ids or just hash them? recommended: emit `key_fingerprint` not raw key id, and mark any key-change events as restricted.

ashley: agreed. redact raw key material. use hashed `key_fingerprint` and include `key_rotation_event` with actor metadata. add to auth and runtime owners.

priya: ETA on tickets — i'll have all five tickets created by EOD tomorrow. PRs can be linked to tickets as they come.

matt: i'll push a draft PR for gateway + runtime by Friday. will call out fallback and response_size changes. :thumbsup:

devon: will draft the JSON schema for exports and a small validation script. aiming for Monday.

ashley: follow-ups: 1) priya — tickets by EOD tomorrow, 2) matt — gateway/runtime PR draft by Friday, 3) devon — export schema by Mon, 4) ashley — will coordinate customer-facing validation and handbook updates. we'll run a quick follow-up sync Thu next week.

priya: noted. I'll tag the tickets with `release:next` and `compliance:customer` where relevant.

matt: minor: for auth token events, include `actor_ip`, `actor_user_agent` to help fraud detection. adding that to auth ticket.

security-bot: reminder set for `2025-05-12T15:00:00Z` to check ticket progress.

ashley: thanks everyone. i'll post this summary to the audit board after priya creates the tickets. :eyes:

priya: done — tickets created: ACD-1423 (api-gateway), ACD-1424 (auth), ACD-1425 (console), ACD-1426 (billing), ACD-1427 (runtime). linking them in the audit board now.

matt: ACK. will link the draft PRs shortly.

devon: ACK, i'll start schema PR and include sample exports for customer validation.

ashley: closing thread — thanks.
